def click_sel(sel):
    r=cdp('DOM.getDocument')
    n=cdp('DOM.querySelector', nodeId=r['root']['nodeId'], selector=sel)['nodeId']
    bid=cdp('DOM.describeNode', nodeId=n)['node']['backendNodeId']
    cdp('DOM.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded', backendNodeId=bid)
    q=cdp('DOM.getBoxModel', backendNodeId=bid)['model']['content']
    click_at_xy(sum(q[0::2])/4, sum(q[1::2])/4)
